name: root
title: build2me: a prove2me-style protocol for building software with parallel agents
interface: A protocol (PROTOCOL.md) plus a zero-dependency toolset that lets many agents build one software project concurrently: immutable contract DAG, lock-free optimistic coordination, per-contract machine-checkable acceptance, cascade verification, and a frontier query that tells any agent what to work on next.
nl_description: The whole system. Done when every child contract is Done and the frontier of this repository is empty.
